title: Long-Term Visual Quality and Pupil Changes after Small-Incision Lenticule Extraction for Eyes without Preoperative Cylinder Refraction

indication: myopia without preoperative cylinder refraction (inclusion: cylinder refraction = 0 D, stable myopia); one (right) eye per patient

groups.description: SMILE (VisuMax femtosecond laser), myopic eyes without preoperative cylinder, 33 right eyes of 33 patients, prospective; emmetropia as the attempted correction (monovision targets excluded by inclusion criteria); single surgeon

exclusions.what: Table 2 p rows (R3, R6, R9, R12)
Table 4 (group one: eyes with zero cylinder at 30 months versus group two: eyes with postoperative cylinder)
exclusions.reason: groups selected by a postoperative outcome; also preoperative parameters only

exclusions.what: Table 3 (percentage of eyes with induced astigmatism)
Figures 4 and 5 (attempted versus achieved SE; proportions within ±0.50 and ±1.00 D) and Figure 6 (SE stability graph)
exclusions.reason: attempted-versus-achieved fits and proportions are not admissible; figures are not citable cells
sphere only, no follow-up; the Table 2 preoperative SE cell is used as the reference

notes: Target: inclusion criteria require emmetropia as the attempted correction (eyes targeted for monovision excluded); an additional spherical nomogram adjustment was applied for patients under 40 years (Methods 2.2), still aiming at emmetropia; target recorded as plano.

Method: Methods state manifest refraction was measured preoperatively and at each follow-up and Table 2 is titled 'Visual acuity and manifest refraction'; one Methods sentence says SE stability was assessed with postoperative cycloplegic refraction; recorded as manifest following the table title.
The Methods examination schedule lists 1 week, 1, 3, 6 and 30 months; Table 2 also prints a 12-month column, which is extracted as tabulated.
SE equals the preoperative sphere because the preoperative cylinder is zero by inclusion (Results).

Table 2 also tabulates CDVA, sphere and cylinder; aberrations, contrast sensitivity, pupil size and anterior corneal astigmatism are tabulated elsewhere (not extracted; schema 1.0.0 has no such series).
Rows R4, R7 and R10 of Table 2 are empty separator rows; rows with rowspan shift the following p rows.

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: quantitative variables expressed as mean ± standard deviation); columns Preop, 1 week, 1 month, 3 month, 6 month, 12 month, 30 month; per-visit n not reported; no loss to follow-up reported
